title: 第895章 接连破城第894章 收利息
slug: 时空洞天三千法则铸无上
content_zh:
五大修炼命脉尽数摧毁。
整座妖城深处传来接连不断的地脉崩塌闷响。
绵延数万里的灵脉寸寸断裂。
精纯的妖气从裂缝中喷涌而出，又在失去根基后迅速消散。
这座妖族重镇，彻底沦为死寂废城。
妖族数十万载苦心经营的浩瀚根基，一朝尽毁。
此番损失惨重到根本无法估量。
妖族无数年积攒的海量资源、地底灵脉、种族传承，在这一刻尽数化为乌有。
城中侥幸在浩劫中存活下来的低阶妖族，吓得彻底崩溃。
无数小妖四散奔逃，慌乱逃窜。
凄厉的哀嚎声、绝望的哭喊声、杂乱的脚步声交织在一起。
在死寂残破的废墟城池之中，久久回荡不绝。
远方天际，四面八方的妖族支援强者已然全速赶来。
漫天浩荡妖威铺天盖地，遮天蔽日，压得整片天穹微微震颤。
诸多支援妖修气息雄浑可怖。
速度最快的一道妖影，已然出现在十万里之外。
他浑身缠绕血色煞气的强大妖修，赫然是一尊第八境巅峰妖王。
更遥远的天际，数道更加浩瀚恐怖的妖力波动，也正在极速逼近。
整片天地，都在这股恐怖的驰援大势下轻轻颤抖。
柳惊天目光凛冽一扫远方天际。

妖族支援已至，再无逗留必要。
身形骤然一转，先天剑体瞬间催动至极致。
脚下细碎剑意轰然炸开，化作极致迅捷的遁光。
整个人化作一道璀璨刺目的青色剑光，瞬间撤出残破妖城。
连半点残影都未曾留下。
不过短短一息时间，他便横跨万里虚空。
稳稳出现在万里之外的高空，与早已在此等候的凌宇顺利汇合。
两人四目相对，无需多余言语交流，心意已然相通。
两道流光同时冲天而起，破开云层，瞬间破空远去。
就在两人离开的刹那，后方那道极速赶来的血色妖影轰然落地。
巨大的冲击力掀起漫天滚滚烟尘。
可他放眼望去，只剩满目疮痍、遍地废墟的死寂城池。
……
第二座、第三座妖族核心据点接连被毁。
content_en:
The five major cultivation lifelines were all destroyed.
There were continuous muffled sounds of earth veins collapsing deep in the entire demon city.
The spiritual veins stretching for tens of thousands of miles were broken inch by inch.
Pure demonic energy spurted out from the cracks, and then quickly dissipated after losing its foundation.
This monster town was completely reduced to a dead and abandoned city.
The vast foundation that the demon clan had worked hard for hundreds of thousands of years was completely destroyed in one fell swoop.
The losses were too heavy to be measured.
The massive resources, underground spiritual veins, and racial heritage accumulated by the demon clan for countless years were all reduced to nothing at this moment.
The low-level monsters in the city who were lucky enough to survive the catastrophe were so frightened that they completely collapsed.
Countless little demons ran away in all directions, fleeing in panic.
The shrill wails, desperate cries, and chaotic footsteps were intertwined.
In the dead silence and broken ruins of the city, it echoed for a long time.
In the distant sky, demon clan support and strong men from all directions are already rushing in at full speed.
The mighty demonic power filled the sky, covering the sky and the sun, causing the entire sky to tremble slightly.
The auras of many supporting demon cultivators are powerful and terrifying.
The fastest demonic figure had already appeared a hundred thousand miles away.
He was a powerful demon cultivator wrapped in blood-colored evil aura, and he was clearly a demon king at the peak of the eighth realm.
In the more distant sky, several more vast and terrifying waves of demonic power are approaching at an extremely fast speed.
The whole world was trembling slightly under this terrifying rush for help.
Liu Jingtian's piercing gaze swept across the distant sky.
The demon clan's support has arrived, there is no need to stay any longer.
The figure suddenly turned around, and the innate sword body was instantly activated to the extreme.
The fragments of sword intent under his feet exploded, turning into extremely fast escaping light.
His whole body turned into a bright and dazzling blue sword light, and he withdrew from the Broken Demon City in an instant.
Not even an afterimage was left behind.
In just one breath, he traveled thousands of miles across the void.
He appeared steadily in the sky thousands of miles away and successfully merged with Ling Yu, who had been waiting here for a long time.
The two people looked at each other, no need for extra words to communicate, their minds were already connected.
Two streams of light rose into the sky at the same time, breaking through the clouds and disappearing in an instant.
The moment the two of them left, the bloody demonic figure coming from behind suddenly landed.
The huge impact sent billowing smoke and dust all over the sky.
But when he looked around, all he could see was the devastated, dead city with ruins everywhere.
…
The second and third demon clan core strongholds were destroyed one after another.
